evidence_basis: Sections read whole, in this event: abstract, Introduction (4 paragraphs), Results (all subsections including the stiripentol section), Discussion (5 paragraphs), Materials and Methods (all subsections, including the intracranial implantation paragraph and the intracellular lactate paragraph).

Figures: captions of Figures 1 to 6 and Expanded View Figures 1 to 5 read in full as text; no figure image was opened in this event (the earlier event opened Figures 2 and 6 and is not repeated here), so panel values are not attested here. Tables: none in the body. Limitations: the paper has no limitations section or paragraph. Not read in this event: Appendix (Figs S1 to S10), Expanded View datasets, source-data workbooks, the reference list.

Observations that bear on the consumers, all from the text read: (1) the stiripentol dose 150 mg/kg stands in the Results and in the Fig 6F legend, while the Methods print 100 mg/kg ip three times a week in the sentence that also gives the bevacizumab and phenformin schedule, inside the intracranial-implantation paragraph whose cohort size is n = 8, against n = 15 to 16 in the Fig 6F legend; (2) no Methods paragraph describes the stiripentol in vitro treatment, its vehicle or its preparation; (3) the Ethical issues paragraph says mice were randomly allocated to treatment groups, whereas the Statistical analysis paragraph says the experiments were not randomized and investigators were not blinded; (4) the blood-brain-barrier crossing and cerebral LDHA/B inhibition are attributed to Sada et al, 2015 and are not shown in this paper; (5) a sentence of the Results on basal lactate in the knockout cells cites Fig 6C where the content belongs to Fig 3C.
